transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Occupational health sent me. They’re saying my weight is… dangerously low, I guess, especially for the press and fabrication work I do all day. I didn’t really see it that way. I thought I was just getting leaner, more disciplined.
Were you trying to lose weight?

I… yes, I suppose so. Most days I just have coffee before the early shift, maybe half a protein bar at lunch. Then after yoga I’ll have a small bowl of vegetables. If I eat more than that, it feels like the whole day gets out of control.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
Yes. I don’t like saying it, but… if the scale goes up even a little, I panic. It feels like I’ll lose control and end up heavy again.
Do you ever eat a large amount of food in a short period of time?
I don’t think so. I mean… not what I’d call a large amount. I’m usually pretty careful.
Do you ever feel like you've lost control while eating?
I’m not sure. I don’t really… let myself get to that point, I guess. I usually stop before it feels like that.
Do you ever make yourself vomit after eating?
I… no, not really. I don’t usually do that.
Do you ever eat much more quickly than usual during these times when you're eating?
I don’t really notice that. I guess I try to eat slowly… so, no, not more quickly than usual.
Do you ever use laxatives or diuretics after eating?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, not after eating, no.
Do you ever feel like you're eating an amount of food that's definitely larger than what most people would eat under similar circumstances?
I don’t think so… I mean, I don’t really eat amounts like that. At least not that I’d call bigger than other people.
Do you think you would still try to limit your food intake if you weren't worried about gaining weight?
I think… yes. If the scale goes up even a little, I get really panicky, like I’m going to lose control and end up heavy again. So I’d still try to limit it.
Do you think your weight is a problem because of how it looks or because of your health?

I mean… they say it’s health. My family keeps saying I look sick, and the nurse at work acted like it was some kind of emergency. But I’m still doing double shifts, still running, still getting things done, so… I don’t see how it can be that serious.
Is your goal with eating and exercise to be as thin as possible?

I don’t know if I’d say “as thin as possible.” It’s more… when I catch myself in a shop window or the bathroom mirror, I just see my stomach and thighs looking too big. Then it kind of ruins my whole day, so I try to do something about it.
Do you ever feel like you've eaten an amount of food that's much larger than what you intended to eat?
I… don’t know. I don’t really think of it that way. Sometimes I feel like I ate more than I meant to, but “much larger”… I’m not sure.
Do you ever feel like you've eaten an amount of food that's much larger than what you intended to eat, and at the same time, feel like you couldn't stop eating?
I’m not sure. I don’t think I… lose control like that. Sometimes I feel bad after eating more than I planned, but I wouldn’t say I couldn’t stop.
Do you ever feel like you've eaten an amount of food that's much larger than what you intended to eat?
I don’t really know how to measure that. Sometimes it feels like more than I wanted, but… I wouldn’t know if it counts as “much larger.”
Do you think you would still be worried about your weight if you didn't think it affected your appearance?

I think… yeah, I probably would. It’s hard to separate it. Like if I catch myself in a shop window or the bathroom mirror, I just see my stomach or my thighs looking too big, and then it sort of… ruins the rest of the day.
Is your fear of gaining weight mostly because of how you think it will make you look?
Mostly… I guess. But it’s also the number. If the scale goes up even a little, I panic, like I’m going to lose control and end up heavy again.
Is your fear of gaining weight because you want to maintain a certain body shape?
Yeah… I think so. It’s about keeping things a certain way, I guess. If the scale goes up even a little, I panic—like I’m going to lose all the control I’ve worked for and end up heavy again.
Do you ever have episodes where you eat a large amount of food in a short period of time, despite feeling like you didn't want to?
I… I don’t really know. Not like I’d call it that, I guess. Sometimes I eat more than I meant to, but I don’t know if it’s a “large amount.”
Is your fear of gaining weight because you want to maintain a certain weight?
Yeah… I think so. It’s the weight, the number. If it goes up even a little, I just… panic, like I’m losing control and I’ll end up heavy again.
